[{"insert":"Fatigued Abdominals

This one breaks a hard core workout into smaller chunks so you can keep moving. Each round drops in reps, so don't blow up on the first round; pace it from the start. The weighted L crunches load your abs directly, while the jump lunges and bike keep your legs and lungs busy. Steady effort across all four rounds beats going out too hot and stalling.
"}]
